topic: 成年海马神经发生：分子机制、模式分离功能、人类存在争议

sources.citation: Eriksson PS, Perfilieva E, Björk-Eriksson T, et al. (1998). Neurogenesis in the adult human hippocampus. Nature Medicine, 4(11):1313-1317.
sources.key_content: 第一个人类组织学证据证明成年海马DG有新神经元生成（BrdU+NeuN双标）
sources.used_for: 历史背景，首次人类证据

sources.citation: Spalding KL, Bergmann O, Alkass K, et al. (2013). Dynamics of hippocampal neurogenesis in adult humans. Cell, 153(6):1219-1227.
sources.key_content: 碳-14定年证明约1/3颗粒细胞持续更新，年更新率1.75%，约700个新神经元/天
sources.used_for: 人类神经发生规模的客观定量证据

sources.citation: Clelland CD, Choi M, Romberg C, et al. (2009). A functional role for adult hippocampal neurogenesis in spatial pattern separation. Science, 325(5937):210-213.
sources.key_content: X射线选择性破坏SGZ分裂细胞，损害精细空间模式分离（必要性因果证据）
sources.used_for: 神经发生对模式分离的必要性因果证据

sources.citation: Sahay A, Scobie KN, Hill AS, et al. (2011). Increasing adult hippocampal neurogenesis is sufficient to improve pattern separation. Nature, 472(7344):466-470.
sources.key_content: 遗传提高新生细胞存活率（神经发生↑50%），情景恐惧辨别任务显著改善（充分性因果证据）
sources.used_for: 神经发生对模式分离的充分性因果证据

sources.citation: Sorrells SF, Paredes MF, Cebrian-Silla A, et al. (2018). Human hippocampal neurogenesis drops sharply in children to undetectable levels in adults. Nature, 555(7696):377-381.
sources.key_content: 59例脑样本，DCX免疫组化，成人DCX+细胞几乎无法检测；后被认为受样本过度固定影响
sources.used_for: 人类神经发生争议的阴性一方

sources.citation: Boldrini M, Fulmore CA, Tartt AN, et al. (2018). Human hippocampal neurogenesis persists throughout aging. Cell Stem Cell, 22(4):589-599.
sources.key_content: 28例优化处理样本，老年人海马仍有数千个未成熟神经元，终身持续
sources.used_for: 人类神经发生争议的阳性一方

sources.citation: Moreno-Jiménez EP, Flor-García M, Terreros-Roncal J, et al. (2019). Adult hippocampal neurogenesis is abundant in neurologically healthy subjects and drops sharply in patients with Alzheimer's disease. Nature Medicine, 25(4):554-560.
sources.key_content: 严格控制固定时间（≤24h）发现健康个体～43,000 DCX+/mm²；AD患者随分期显著下降；揭示过固定是Sorrells et al.假阴性的根源
sources.used_for: 方法论破局，AD-神经发生关联

sources.citation: Zhou Y, et al. (2022). Single-nucleus transcriptomics in adult and aging human hippocampus. PMID: 35922666, PMCID: PMC9373098.
sources.access_note: PMC开放全文（信息来自综合综述引用摘要）
sources.key_content: 机器学习识别snRNA-seq中的未成熟颗粒细胞（3.1-7.5%）；在Sorrells等原始样本中也检测到神经发生转录组信号
sources.used_for: 独立于DCX蛋白的第二维度人类神经发生证据

sources.citation: Aimone JB, Li Y, Lee SW, Bhaskaran MD, Bhaskaran K, Bhaskaran J (2021). A functional model of adult dentate gyrus neurogenesis. PMID: 34137370, PMCID: PMC8260225.
sources.key_content: 计算模型揭示GABA开关的两阶段功能：协作期（兴奋性GABA→突触权重朝现有记忆初始化）→竞争期（抑制性GABA→特化为新颖相似模式）

sources.citation: Chen S, et al. (2025). Adult hippocampal neurogenesis: New avenues for treatment of brain disorders. PMID: 40816272, PMCID: PMC12447344.
sources.key_content: 综述神经发生调节通路（BDNF/Wnt/Shh/Notch）；AD中神经发生刺激改善认知不依赖淀粉样蛋白；SSRI/运动/氯胺酮的神经发生效应
sources.used_for: 调节机制和治疗潜力综述

sources.citation: Disouky A, Sanborn MA, Sabitha KR, et al. (2026). Human hippocampal neurogenesis in adulthood, ageing and Alzheimer's disease. Nature. DOI: 10.1038/s41586-026-10169-4.
sources.access_note: 未读取全文（付费墙重定向），信息来自官方Nature新闻稿和数据库记录
sources.key_content: 355,997核多组学单细胞测序；覆盖SuperAgers/正常老人/MCI/AD；AD最早变化在NSC阶段；认知损害与神经母细胞改变相关
sources.used_for: 最新2026年大规模证据（摘要级别）
